intro.text: One of the larger cities of the Vamah princedom in Alethkar, near a tributary of the Windrunner River and a few weeks' walk from Hearthstone.

description.text: Revolar sits in a hollow among hills and has long since spilled past its old walls, which now mark the inner city, to sprawl up the slopes. Unlike the warcamps, its layout is disorganized.
Army barracks and parshmen's quarters lie outside the city to the east. Caravans run regularly to Kholinar, and caravaneers and couriers stay on the outskirts.
It is the seat of Highprince Vamah, and Highlord Paladar ruled it as regent in his absence, to the city's cost.

items.text: After the Everstorm, singer forces took the city and tens of thousands of singers came to occupy it; parshmen from across the region were led there by spren, many going on to Kholinar. Kaladin travelled to Revolar with a group of parshmen, and escaped in a highstorm after trying to help human captives outside the city reach shelter.

Human captives were held in the city's storm bunkers and signed up for hard, basic or skilled labour; the singers especially wanted smiths, fletchers and armorers. High-ranking lighteyes such as Paladar used their status to avoid the work. Moash was brought there and volunteered to haul carts to Kholinar.
